newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 6.82 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 6.82 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 17.0 trillion lire 28-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 6.82 percent, compared with 6.77 percent at the previous repo tender on May 26, the Bank said.
The average rate was 6.89 percent against 6.81 percent at the last repurchase pact for 13.0 trillion lire and 21 days.
The pact covers purchases today and tomorrow and the securities are for resale on June 30. The Bank said it received 53 bids of which 44 were met in full and two in part.
